settings.aboutDescription: A video player for movies and series: almost every format, subtitles from the internet chosen for your release, sync to the speech and continue watching.
settings.aspectHint: Used for every video you open. While watching, O switches the aspect ratio.
settings.audioDelayHint: Positive values play the sound later, negative values earlier. Useful for Bluetooth headphones. Subtitle sync is set separately (Subtitles tab, and Z/X or G/H while watching).
settings.audioDeviceHint: Changes right away. With “System default device”, the sound follows the device chosen in Windows.
settings.audioLanguageHint: When a video has several audio tracks, this language is chosen. While watching, you can switch with B or the audio button.
settings.autoNext: Automatically play the next episode at the end
settings.autoNextHint: When off, a card only offers the next episode (Enter plays it).
settings.generalHint: Playback, series, screenshots and Windows integration.
settings.gpuUi: Render the interface on the GPU
settings.gpuUiHint: Takes effect after a restart. Off is more reliable (on some computers GPU rendering of the interface leaves white windows). Video is always rendered on the GPU.
settings.hdrHint: Off: HDR videos are converted for a normal display (works everywhere). On: needs an HDR monitor with “Use HDR” turned on in Windows Settings → Display.
settings.hdrPassthrough: Use the HDR mode of the display when HDR is on in Windows
settings.hideControlsHint: Without mouse movement, the bottom controls and the Home button hide together. They stay visible while the video is paused.
settings.historyHint: The history is included in the player and works without the internet.
settings.hwdecHint: The graphics card decodes the video: less CPU and power use. Turn it off only if the picture is broken or green.
settings.languageHint: Changes right away, across the whole player.
settings.languageRemembered: The chosen language is remembered and stays after a restart and after updates.
settings.languageSubtitlesHint: Subtitle languages and their order are set in the Subtitles tab.
settings.licenseText: jebaited_player is free and open source software under the GNU General Public License v3.0.
settings.manualHint: The manual opens on GitHub in your language (English, German or Croatian).
settings.normalize: Even out loud and quiet scenes (volume levelling)
settings.normalizeHint: Useful at night: dialogue is easier to hear and explosions are quieter.
settings.eqHint: Changes are heard right away. When you boost bands, the overall level is lowered automatically so the sound does not distort. Moving a slider saves your own preset (Custom). Films and series have their own equalizer, music and radio their own; the one for what is playing is used.
settings.onTop: Keep the player above other windows while a video is playing
settings.privacyText: jebaited_player has no account, ads or tracking. It only connects to GitHub (update check, can be turned off) and to the subtitle sites you set up (searching and downloading subtitles), and, only when you use the radio, to the Radio Browser station directory and the station you play.
settings.qualityHigh: High quality (sharper scaling, smoother gradients; more load on the graphics card)
settings.qualityHint: Changes right away, also during playback.
settings.resumeHint: The position is always saved (also with the Home button), so “Continue watching” on the home screen keeps working.
settings.resumeLabel: When you open a video you have already started:
settings.savedHint: Changes apply right away. Save keeps them, Discard changes goes back to the last save; closing the window also saves them.
settings.defaultsConfirmTab: Set the “{0}” tab back to its default values? Language, keys and passwords, volume and window positions stay. Press Save to keep the result.
settings.defaultsConfirmAll: Set all settings back to their default values? Language, keys and passwords, volume and window positions stay. Press Save to keep the result.
settings.screenshotsHint: S = screenshot with subtitles, Shift+S = picture only. Saved as JPG at the full video resolution.
settings.seekStep: Left and right arrow keys jump
settings.setDefaultHint: Windows does not let programs make themselves the default. Windows Settings will open: click “Set default” (or choose the file types one by one).
settings.shellNotRegistered: jebaited_player is not registered in Windows (it is not in “Open with”).
settings.shellOther: Another copy of the player is registered ({0}). “Set as default player” moves the registration to this one.
settings.shellRegistered: Registered: video and audio files have “Open with → jebaited_player”.
settings.shellStore: File types are registered by the Microsoft Store package. To make jebaited_player your default player, choose it in Default apps.
settings.singleInstanceHint: A file opened while the player is running goes to the open player, so there is never a second window.
settings.backupStatus: Your settings and watch history are backed up automatically once a day and before every update; the last {0} backups are kept. Last backup: {1}.
settings.backupNone: Your settings and watch history are backed up automatically once a day and before every update; the last {0} backups are kept. No backup yet.
settings.transferHint: Export saves your settings to a file you choose (without passwords and keys for subtitle sites, and without the window position). Import replaces your current settings; they are backed up first. A settings.json from the backup folder can be imported too.
settings.importInvalid: This file is not a jebaited_player settings file. Nothing was changed.
settings.importConfirm: Replace your current settings with the settings from “{0}”? Your current settings are backed up first.
settings.technologiesHint: jebaited_player is built on these open source projects:
settings.themeHint: Changes right away. The controls over the video stay dark so they are easy to see on the picture.
settings.title: Settings
settings.updatesHint: A new version is downloaded in the background and installed when you close the player. Settings, watch history and keys are kept.
settings.updatesHintStore: This is the Microsoft Store version: new versions are installed by Microsoft Store. Settings, watch history and keys are kept.
settings.volumeHint: The volume is remembered. While watching: mouse wheel or the up and down arrow keys, M mutes.
shell.description: Lightweight video player that finds and syncs subtitles automatically.
shortcut.subtitleDelay: Subtitles earlier / later (100 ms; Shift 1 s, Ctrl 10 ms)
shortcut.subtitleFiles: Load subtitles from file / search the internet
shortcut.subtitleToggle: Show or hide subtitles / next subtitles
shortcut.zx: Sync: I hear the line, then its subtitle
sources.autoSearch: Search the internet when there are no subtitles in the first language on the list
sources.keyOptional: An API key is not needed (the player has its own); enter one only if you want to use your own.
sources.osHint: The only source that recognizes the exact release by the file fingerprint. 5 downloads a day without an account, more with a free account.
sources.podnapisiHint: Podnapisi.net: the site is currently down (the domain has no address), so it is not included.
sources.saveNext: Save downloaded subtitles next to the video (e.g. Movie.en.srt)
sources.securityHint: Keys and passwords are stored encrypted (Windows DPAPI) and are only sent to the source they belong to.
sources.subdlHint: Large database, searches by title, season and episode. Free API key.
sources.title: Subtitle sources
sources.titloviHint: The largest database of Croatian subtitles. Uses the interface of the official Kodi add-on with your account. The terms of use for other apps are not publicly confirmed, so it stays off until you turn it on yourself.
sources.whereKey: Where do I get a key?
subSettings.autoLoad: Automatically load local subtitles with the same name as the video
subSettings.autoSync: Check and sync external subtitles to the speech in the video
subSettings.encodingHint: UTF-8 and UTF-16 subtitles are always read correctly, and the encoding of older subtitles is detected automatically. Choose one only if the letters (č, ć, ž, š, đ) look wrong in most of your subtitles. A single file can be changed while watching: Subtitles → Encoding.
subSettings.languagesHint: The first available language from the list is used. If none is available, no subtitles are shown.
subSettings.sourcesHint: OpenSubtitles, SubDL and Titlovi.com: accounts and keys, or the guide that sets them up in two minutes.
subSettings.styleHint: Changes are visible on the video right away. ASS subtitles keep their own styles.
subSettings.syncHint: Manual corrections while watching: G/H move the subtitles by 0.1 s (Ctrl = 0.01 s, Shift = 1 s), Z/X align them by line, A syncs them to the speech again and Ctrl+Backspace resets. More options: Subtitles → Subtitle synchronization.
subs.mappedFailed: The corrected subtitles were not loaded: {0}
sync.anchorHint: 1. Pause the video when you hear a line begin (Space; comma and period step one frame back and forward).  2. Select that line in the list and click ‘This line starts now’.  If the subtitles drift again further into the video (e.g. after a scene change), repeat there: the player works out the offset, speed or a piecewise correction from the points.
sync.delayBoxTip: Type the exact offset in seconds (e.g. −2.5) and press Enter
sync.delayHeader: 2. Offset: all subtitles earlier or later
sync.delayHint: When the subtitles are always equally late or early. Minus = subtitles earlier, plus = later. Keys G / H (0.1 s), with Shift 1 s.
sync.fpsHint: Only when the subtitles were made for a different frame rate (e.g. PAL DVD 25 fps, but the video is 23.976 fps). A wrong choice can shift the subtitles by a minute at the end of the video.
sync.gradualEarlyTip: Further into the video, subtitles come later and later
sync.gradualHeader: 3. Subtitles gradually drift late or early
sync.gradualHint: When the subtitles are right where you are now, but drift more and more later or earlier further into the video. The line on screen now stays where it is; each click changes 0.5 s per 10 minutes.
sync.gradualLateTip: Further into the video, subtitles come earlier and earlier
sync.resetTip: Restore the subtitles as they are in the file (Ctrl+Backspace)
sync.title: Subtitle synchronization
sync.zxHeader: Classic way: keys Z and X during playback
sync.zxHint: Press Z when you hear a line and X when its subtitle appears (the order does not matter).
syncDetail.littleSpeech: too little audio or speech ({0:0} s, speech {1:P0})
syncDetail.mismatch: the lines do not match the speech
syncDetail.parts: subtitles for a different release: {0} parts, offset from {1:+0.0;-0.0} to {2:+0.0;-0.0} s ({3} of {4} parts match)
syncDetail.uncertainParts: subtitles for a different release, but only {0:P0} of the lines were measured reliably
syncDetail.weak: the match is too weak ({0:P0} of the lines reliable)
update.downloaded: New version {0} has been downloaded. It will be installed when you close the player.
update.failed: The check failed (no internet connection or GitHub is not responding). I will try again later.
update.notInstalled: Updates work in the installed version (this one was started outside the installation).
update.store: Updates are installed by Microsoft Store.
wizard.enterKeyToo: Enter the API key too (see the instructions below the field).
wizard.introText: When a video has no subtitles, the player searches the internet for them, checks them against the speech in the video and syncs them. This needs a free account with at least one subtitle source. It takes about two minutes.
wizard.laterHint: Later: right-click the video → Subtitles → “Set up subtitles from the internet…” (this guide) or “Subtitle sources (keys)…”.
wizard.noConnection: No connection to the source. Check your internet connection.
wizard.osHaveAccount: If you already have an account, skip to step 4.
wizard.osIntro: The most subtitles, and the only source that recognizes the exact release of your video. You only need a username and password.
wizard.osIntroWithKey: The most subtitles, and the only source that recognizes the exact release of your video. You need a username, a password and a free API key.
wizard.osKeyHelp: This version of the player has no built-in app key, so it also needs your API key: on the keys page click “New consumer”, enter any name (e.g. jebaited_player), save and copy the “API key”.
wizard.osStep2: Enter a username, e-mail and password and confirm the sign-up (the site may also ask you to confirm you are not a robot).
wizard.osStep3: Open the e-mail from OpenSubtitles and click the link to confirm your account (check your spam folder too).
wizard.osStep4: Enter the same username and password here:
wizard.pasteSubdlKey: Paste the API key from the SubDL website.
wizard.securityHint: Passwords and keys are stored encrypted (Windows DPAPI) only on this computer and are only sent to the source they belong to.
wizard.subdlIntro: Extra subtitles when OpenSubtitles has none. Needs a key from their website (copy and paste).
wizard.subdlStep1: Open SubDL and sign in. If you have no account, create one (Sign up) and confirm your e-mail.
wizard.subdlStep2: On the “API” page, copy your API key (Ctrl+C).
wizard.summary.none: No account is set up. You can open the guide whenever you like.
wizard.summary.osNoAccount: – OpenSubtitles: no account (at most 5 downloads a day)
wizard.summary.ready: When a video has no subtitles in your language, the player will search for them automatically.
wizard.timeout: The source is not responding. Check your internet connection and try again.
wizard.title: Subtitles from the internet – setup
wizard.titloviHint: The player uses the same interface as the official Titlovi.com add-on for Kodi, with your account. The terms of use for other apps are not publicly confirmed, so this source is optional.
wizard.titloviIntro: Large Croatian database. Username and password.
wizard.titloviStep1: Open titlovi.com and create an account (Registracija), then confirm your e-mail.
wizard.titloviStep2: Enter your username and password here:
